one_line: 12th‑century mathematician–astronomer of Vijjadavida and Ujjain, author of Siddhanta Shiromani.

appearance.age_look: Late 40s, lean and scholarly, with a straight but relaxed posture suggesting long hours of study rather than warfare.
appearance.face: Oval face with medium‑brown dusky complexion, calm sharp eyes, straight medium nose, neatly trimmed black moustache and short beard along the jawline, a small sandalwood tilaka on the forehead, default expression gentle, focused, slightly curious.
appearance.hair: Straight black hair, shoulder‑length, neatly parted in the middle and tucked behind ears, gathered loosely at the back with a thin ochre cloth tie; simple white cloth headband resting above the tilaka, no crown or ornate turban.
appearance.costume: Era‑accurate 12th‑century scholarly dress: a full‑length cream cotton dhoti wrapped securely from waist to ankles with a neat front pleat, worn with a fitted long‑sleeved kurta‑like upper garment in soft light saffron cotton reaching mid‑thigh, a thin woven border in muted maroon at cuffs and hem; over this, a plain white cotton angavastra draped over both shoulders and hanging evenly down the front, edges lightly bordered in maroon; simple leather sandals on feet; minimal jewellery—small gold stud earrings and a single thin gold chain at the neck; no royal ornaments.
appearance.signature: A rolled palm‑leaf manuscript tied with a maroon cord in one hand and a simple wooden hand‑held gnomon/sundial in the other, with an open cloth‑wrapped bundle of palm‑leaf manuscripts at his side.

ref_desc: Bhaskara II appears as a lean late‑40s scholar with medium‑brown skin, shoulder‑length tied black hair, sandalwood tilaka, cream dhoti, light saffron long‑sleeved upper garment, white maroon‑bordered angavastra, simple gold studs, leather sandals, and carries a rolled palm‑leaf manuscript and wooden gnomon in cream, saffron, white, maroon tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full‑body anime‑style model sheet of Bhaskara II (Bhaskaracharya), a 12th‑century Indian mathematician‑astronomer, as a lean man in his late 40s with medium‑brown skin, an oval face, calm sharp eyes, straight medium nose, and a neatly trimmed black moustache with short beard along the jawline. His straight black hair is shoulder‑length, parted in the middle, tucked behind the ears, and loosely tied at the back with a thin ochre cloth tie, and he wears a simple white cloth headband with a small sandalwood tilaka on his forehead. Dress him in a historically plausible cream cotton dhoti wrapped from waist to ankles with a precise front pleat, a fitted long‑sleeved light saffron cotton upper garment reaching mid‑thigh with a thin muted maroon woven border at the cuffs and hem, and a plain white cotton angavastra draped over both shoulders and hanging down the front with a subtle maroon edge. Add simple leather sandals, tiny gold stud earrings, and a single thin gold chain at his neck, avoiding any royal or fantasy armor. In his hands, show a rolled palm‑leaf manuscript tied with a maroon cord and a small wooden hand‑held gnomon or sundial, with an open cloth‑wrapped bundle of additional palm‑leaf manuscripts resting near him. Use a palette dominated by cream, light saffron, white, maroon, and medium brown, and present him in neutral, clear poses front, side, and back to emphasize consistent face, hair, costume details, and his scholarly signature props.
